title: Machine Learning
content: Machine learning is a field of artificial intelligence in which systems learn patterns from data to make predictions or decisions.

title: Vector Search
content: Vector search represents documents and queries as numerical embeddings, then retrieves nearby vectors using exact or approximate nearest neighbor search.

title: FAISS
content: FAISS is a library for efficient similarity search over dense vectors. It supports exact flat indexes and approximate indexes such as IVF and HNSW.

title: RAG
content: Retrieval augmented generation first retrieves relevant documents, then provides those documents as context for a language model answer.

title: Agent Tool Use
content: Agent workloads often alternate between model calls and tools such as search, shell commands, browser actions, and file operations.
